proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ _ _ n A
  have h : (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have e : Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin n → Ω => ¬ ∃ i, ω i ∈ A) = Fintype.piFinset (fun _ => Aᶜ) := by
    ext ω; simp
  have hc := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n → Ω))) (fun ω => ∃ i, ω i ∈ A)
  rw [e, Fintype.card_piFinset] at hc
  simp only [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_fun] at hc
  have hA : (Aᶜ.card : ℝ) + A.card = Fintype.card Ω := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_compl_add_card A
  have e2 : 1 - (A.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω = (Aᶜ.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω := by
    field_simp; linarith
  have hc' : ((Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin n → Ω => ∃ i, ω i ∈ A)).card : ℝ) + (Aᶜ.card : ℝ) ^ n = (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ) ^ n := by exact_mod_cast hc
  rw [e2, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin, div_pow]
  push_cast
  have hp : (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ) ^ n ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero n h
  field_simp
  linarith
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω] [Nonempty Ω] (n : ℕ) (A : Finset Ω), ((Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin n → Ω => ∃ i, ω i ∈ A)).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card (Fin n → Ω) = 1 - (1 - (A.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω) ^ n
